verdict.rationale: Cloudflare AI Gateway provides an OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions endpoint and a Universal endpoint that let developers call Workers AI, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Replicate, and more through one consistent API by simply switching model/apiKey params, with unified billing, logging, and fallback across providers. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration beyond first-party docs, and more detail on edge cases like provider-specific parameter differences.
